note: The rune chain. A route, like the rail loop — not a biome. It enters from the sea at the west edge, passes through every settlement in the territory as a node, and leaves east past the colonnade into the sea. RUNES appear only at the nodes; between them only the connecting groove crosses, so a cell the chain merely passes through carries a groove and nothing else. L2 carries the carving only: any light travelling along it belongs to an effect layer and must NOT be painted here (owner 2026-09-04: 'that would be on an effect layer').

nodes.of: the seaward end, where the chain leaves the world

groove: a SLOT CUT DOWN INTO THE BEDROCK, not a line drawn on top of it — 2-3 m wide and about 2 m deep, deep enough that a person could stand in it with their head at ground level. It has two cut walls and a floor, and it reads dark inside because the depth shades it, NOT because anything glows. ANCIENT AND WEATHERED: the cut edges rounded and softened, lichen in the joints, grass and low scrub overhanging the lip in places, a little scree and fallen rubble on the floor, and the odd stretch where the wall has slumped. Nobody has maintained this in a very long time. But it never wanders and it is never lost: the line stays true across the whole cell and you can follow it by eye from one edge to the other. Do not draw it as a path, a road, a kerb, a wall or a low ridge — the ground is REMOVED along it.
rune: large panels of cut rock set into the level ground FLANKING the groove, each 6-8 m across, deeply incised, all the same size and depth, each a DIFFERENT mark — a sentence, not a repeated stamp. Weathered like the groove: edges rounded, lichen in the cuts, some marks part-lost to time. None larger than the others, and nothing standing at the middle of the cluster: every node equal. Six to ten of them at a node, close enough to read as one utterance.
water: NO WATER ON THE CHAIN. A beck may pass beneath the groove or stop short of it, but no pool, tarn, stream or wet ground may sit ON the line or cross it in the open — water there is cut out of this layer and leaves a hole, which severs the chain. The first attempt at this cell put two pools directly on the line and broke it inside a single cell.
